signals.thesis: Mistral AI launched Mistral Large 4, a new flagship model documented in its official release notes, drawing substantial developer attention. This adds another well-funded European entrant to the frontier LLM race against OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic, with implications for enterprise AI pricing and cloud/compute demand.
signals.title: Mistral releases Large 4, intensifying frontier-model competition

signals.thesis: Reporting describes significant privacy and security flaws in Meta's Muse product, generating strong community scrutiny. This raises regulatory and reputational risk for Meta as it pushes consumer AI features, a relevant watch point given past precedent of privacy issues triggering fines or forced product changes.
signals.title: Meta's Muse AI product faces privacy and security backlash
